articles.title: US strikes 3 vessels and leaves survivors -- now a search-and-rescue operation
articles.summary: U.S. Southern Command recently targeted three vessels in a convoy operating in international waters. The operation aimed at combating "narco-terrorists," with survivors reportedly jumping overboard. This action underscores ongoing international military efforts to disrupt illicit drug trafficking routes and counter associated terrorism, highlighting the critical role of maritime security in global counter-narcotics operations.

articles.title: New year of hope for disabled military cadets: A new health cover that cuts costs
articles.summary: Shubham Gupta recently secured entry into the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) via a temporary slip. This vital scheme provides free medical treatment for ex-servicemen and their dependents at military hospitals and empanelled private facilities. ECHS ensures comprehensive healthcare support, highlighting the government's commitment to the welfare of its retired armed forces personnel.

articles.title: Putin residence attack video slammed; US officials say Ukraine did not target leader
articles.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry released footage of a Ukrainian drone wreckage, claiming it was intercepted during an attempted nighttime attack on President Vladimir Putin's residence near Moscow. This incident highlights the ongoing tensions and drone warfare in the Russia-Ukraine conflict, demonstrating Ukraine's attempts to strike within Russian territory and Russia's defensive measures against such incursions, a critical aspect for defence aspirants to observe.

articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced a peace deal for the ongoing conflict was "90 percent" ready, as reported by his Presidential Office.
